text: Board members and Economic Development and Culture staff will provide an update on the work of the Ontario Green Screen and ongoing planning for grid-power access to reduce film productions' reliance on diesel generators in Toronto.

The Film, Television and Digital Media Advisory Board recommends that: 1. City Council direct the General Manager, Economic Development and Culture to collaborate with the General Manager, Transportation Services, and the General Manager, Parks, Forestry and Recreation, to develop a business and operational case for a pilot project to install power drops at popular filming locations for consideration as part of the 2022 budget process, or before, wherever possible.
